python3 - HEAD^ <<'PY'
import hashlib, io, json, re, subprocess, sys, tarfile
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', sys.argv[1]], text=True).strip()
root = 'docs/proof/skills-packages-2026-10-07/review-r5-r6/'
command = ['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', head, root]
archive = subprocess.check_output(command)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as bundle:
    files = {item.name: bundle.extractfile(item).read() for item in bundle.getmembers() if item.isfile()}
receipt = json.loads(files[root + 'receipt.json'])
failures = []
contracts = []
for name, expected in receipt['archiveFilesSha256'].items():
    content = files.get(root + name)
    actual = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() if content is not None else None
    contracts.append({'file': name, 'expectedSha256': expected, 'actualSha256': actual})
    if content is None:
        failures.append({'file': name, 'error': 'missing from exported commit'})
    elif actual != expected:
        failures.append({'file': name, 'error': 'receipt SHA256 mismatch'})
links = re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', files[root + 'README.md'].decode())
for link in links:
    if '://' not in link and not link.startswith('#'):
        target = str(PurePosixPath(root) / link.split('#', 1)[0])
        if target not in files:
            failures.append({'link': link, 'error': 'README link missing from exported commit'})
logs = ['before-recipes.log', 'after-recipes.log', 'after-recipes-first-attempt.log', 'browser.log', 'browser-config-failure.log', 'browser-cwd-failure.log']
for name in logs:
    if name not in receipt['archiveFilesSha256']:
        failures.append({'file': name, 'error': 'raw log missing from receipt'})
print(json.dumps({'head': head, 'command': command, 'exportedFiles': len(files), 'receiptContracts': len(contracts), 'READMElinks': len(links), 'requiredRawLogs': len(logs), 'contracts': contracts, 'failures': failures}, indent=2))
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
